researchNotes: Specific Saint Philip apostle vs Philip Neri strictly disambiguated.
Sotheby's Van Dyck Saint Philip panel different from Vienna KHM GG9703, though related Apostle series; original provenance kept separate.
Francisco Herrera Córdoba and Esteban Márquez hospital Seville portrait paintings have actual Commons media files and dates; check true custodian accessions.
Rizi Benedict P02510 blessing bread is a distinct full painting, unlike P003108 blessing Maurus (scene only), P002601 with two angels, or W36 Nicodemo Ferrucci original rated 3.
Simon François Paris Lazarist full/cropped commons photos are same historical portrait, with possible copy lineage; do not create two portrait originals.
Three independently registered French Saint Martin episcopal canvases are genuine, but usable museum-quality image masters have not been acquired and reuse restrictions remain.
All rated prior images excluded from renewed scoring; never infer aesthetic score or fit.

records.title: Saint Benedict Blessing the Bread

records.notes: c.1655 oil 168x148cm, Commons source from Prado 2603x2953. Subject blessing bread (small gesture), institution object P02510; not Rizi P002601 with angels or P003108 blessing Maurus.

records.title: Saint Benedict in Prayer
records.notes: Commons standalone image 788x791; authorship only filename. No museum or original medium confirmed, do not count as independently verified oil.

records.title: St. Benedikt

records.title: Portrait of Saint Vincent de Paul
records.collection: Mission des Lazaristes, Paris (object number not in Commons)
records.notes: 1395x1667; Commons original and 1239x1535 cropped variant are same depicted artwork. Source image Allposters; model reportedly c.1659, follow original custody vs later copies. Do NOT treat copy as separate original.

records.title: Saint Vincent de Paul (three-quarter bust)
records.notes: Signed and dated 1877, oil canvas 53x45cm bust of Vincent in dark clerical dress with skullcap; distinct object and period from Carnavalet P863 and 1659 Simon François model.

records.title: Saint Vincent de Paul portrait, hand on book
records.notes: Already indexed W41-NEW-001! Specific derivative after Simon François, public property, on-book distinctive pose. Preserve old record, avoid import duplicate.

records.title: Saint Vincent de Paul Preaching
records.notes: c.1730 oil canvas 336x287cm French heritage object. Rich life scene not portrait; distinct from Troy deathbed Louis XIII scene SMK KMS7697 and Folleville copy.

records.title: Saint Martin as Bishop, full-length in rich vestments
records.notes: Early 18th c, bishop in richly detailed red and green vestments, crosier and mitre, isolated before classical architecture; photographer GrandPalaisRmn; owner commune; image reproduction requests required.

records.title: Saint Martin as Bishop
records.notes: c.1697 original other parish; detailed bishop clothing in classical setting, restored by Genovesio. Different object, potentially same commission/artist circle as PM78002109, treat separately with clear provenance.
